description: Makes a verbatim LOCAL copy of a web page the user OWNS or is authorized to copy (site migration, backup, lost-source recovery): keeps the page's own CSS, assets and scripts so its real animations re-run, via SingleFile. Gated on recorded authorization; copies the owner's copyrighted code, so it never publishes or hosts. Use when the user says "capture my site exactly", "save the real animations", "verbatim/1:1 copy", "download my site with assets", "mirror this page I own". For someone else's site, or to rebuild cleanly, use replica-crew product mode instead.
